skill.name: database-manager
skill.description: Manages Supabase schema, migrations, RLS policies, and query patterns for the CookMode V2 recipe workflow.
skill.summary: Guides Supabase schema changes, migrations, RLS policies, real-time tables, and database troubleshooting for CookMode V2.
skill.author: AdamFehse

security_audit.summary: The static command-execution and reconnaissance findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, SQL examples, and Supabase configuration text. One semantic configuration risk remains: the skill recommends permissive Supabase RLS policies that allow broad read and write access unless the deployment is a trusted kitchen environment.

remediation.issue: Permissive RLS examples grant all users read and write access.
remediation.suggestion: Replace FOR ALL USING (true) examples with authenticated, role-based, or recipe-scoped policies. Keep any open policy behind an explicit local-only warning.

semantic_findings.title: Permissive Row Level Security Policies
semantic_findings.description: The skill states that all users can read and write all data and shows policies using FOR ALL USING (true). Reusing these examples outside a trusted kitchen can expose or modify shared recipe data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill directly documents permissive RLS and repeats all-access policy examples. It also notes that multi-tenant setups need stricter policies, so this is a configuration risk rather than malicious intent.

content.value_statement: Database changes can break recipe workflows when schema, RLS, and real-time hooks drift. This skill guides Supabase schema design, migrations, policies, and troubleshooting for CookMode V2.
actual_capabilities: Documents the CookMode V2 Supabase tables and their primary keys.
Provides migration structure with table creation, indexes, RLS setup, and rollback notes.
Shows Supabase client patterns for selecting, upserting, and deleting recipe workflow data.
Explains real-time subscription tables used by ingredient, step, status, order, and chef workflows.
Lists troubleshooting checks for sync failures, constraint violations, and RLS access issues.
limitations: The guidance is specific to the CookMode V2 database model.
The included RLS examples assume a trusted environment and need changes for multi-tenant apps.
The skill does not execute migrations or verify a live Supabase project by itself.
Example SQL and JavaScript should be reviewed before use in production.

use_cases.title: Add a Recipe Workflow Table
use_cases.description: Plan a new table with constraints, indexes, RLS policy notes, and real-time integration points.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot Supabase Sync Issues
use_cases.description: Check RLS policies, subscriptions, browser errors, and table configuration when recipe state does not update.

use_cases.title: Review Migration Safety
use_cases.description: Confirm that a database change includes rollback notes, realistic test data, and updated hook documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the Existing Schema
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner orientation before making a database change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the database-manager skill to summarize the CookMode V2 Supabase tables, primary keys, and real-time responsibilities in simple terms.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Safe Migration Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a change plan before writing SQL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the database-manager skill to plan a migration for adding recipe notes. Include table fields, indexes, RLS policy choices, rollback notes, and hook updates.

prompt_templates.title: Debug a Sync Failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the database-manager skill to troubleshoot why recipe_status updates are saved but not appearing on another client. List checks in priority order.

prompt_templates.title: Harden RLS for Production
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced security review for a shared deployment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the database-manager skill to replace permissive RLS guidance with authenticated, recipe-scoped policies for a multi-user production deployment.

output_examples.input: Plan a new recipe notes feature for CookMode V2.
output_examples.output: A migration plan with the table purpose, required fields, index strategy, RLS policy notes, rollback steps, and hooks that need updates.

output_examples.input: Ingredient checks are not syncing between browsers.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting checklist covering real-time subscriptions, RLS policy access, Supabase client connection state, and browser console errors.

output_examples.input: Review whether the current RLS approach is safe for multiple teams.
output_examples.output: A security review that flags permissive access, explains the data exposure risk, and recommends scoped authenticated policies.

best_practices: Test every migration locally with realistic recipe data before applying it.
Use explicit constraints and indexes for fields that drive recipe workflow state.
Update related hooks and documentation whenever schema or access rules change.
anti_patterns: Do not reuse permissive RLS policies in multi-tenant or public deployments.
Do not drop tables or columns without a backup and a rollback path.
Do not change schema fields without checking real-time subscriptions and client hooks.

faq.question: What database does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Supabase PostgreSQL for the CookMode V2 recipe workflow.

faq.question: Can it write a complete migration plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline tables, indexes, RLS policies, rollback notes, and related hook updates.

faq.question: Does it run SQL against Supabase?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples, but it does not execute migrations by itself.

faq.question: Is the documented RLS policy production ready?
faq.answer: Not for multi-tenant use. The open policy is only suitable for a trusted environment.

faq.question: Can it help debug real-time updates?
faq.answer: Yes. It points to subscription checks, table policies, connection state, and browser errors.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
